title: Erlang C staffing calculator
scenario: LFG's steering committee wants to know how many agents Monday needs and what an extra minute of AHT costs. The WFM spreadsheet port returns NaN for the full help desk, undershoots the load and applies shrinkage the wrong way. Build an explainable, numerically stable Erlang C model and a per-interval staffing plan.
task: Erlang B recursion and Erlang C without overflow (500-Erlang center)
Service level, ASA and occupancy with defined unstable and zero-load behavior
agentsRequired with occupancy cap, chat concurrency, shrinkage and validation
staffingPlan for the Monday forecast: per interval, peak and agent-hours
Answer the steering committee's what-if questions in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Matches independently computed Erlang values to 4-5 decimals
Edge cases: unstable queue, zero load, invalid input, impossible ceiling
Monday plan matches the reference interval by interval
ANSWER.md gives the numbers and the limits of Erlang C
